name: @blue-bee/design-tokens
description: Blue Bee canonical design tokens (the 'Daylight' system) — pure-TS typed constants (color light/dark, space, radius, type scale, elevation, motion) + an optional Tailwind preset. No React, no platform imports: imported by the web (Tailwind) and the Expo apps so the look stays consistent across surfaces. Single source of truth; mirrors docs/design/DESIGN-LANGUAGE.md.
